summary: Voters in Sambhal city cite recurring waterlogging and choked drains in the monsoon, a district hospital short of doctors, and a rail link that has not been built, while the municipal board has started a Rs 10 crore road and drain project and a Rs 170 crore drinking water scheme.

positives.english: A Rs 10 crore city road and drain project has started, and work has begun on some roads
positives.hindi: शहर में 10 करोड़ की सड़क-नाला योजना शुरू, कुछ सड़कों पर काम शुरू
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (4 Aug 2026): Nagar Palika says a Rs 10 crore project for streets, drains and sewers has started; Rs 96 lakh work has begun on Bhure Shah Road (Rs 36 lakh), Hauz Bhaddesarai (Rs 21 lakh) and Hatimsarai (Rs 39 lakh); tender under way for the rest across 137 locations; firms to finish in 2-3 months. Article credits repeated newspaper coverage for prompting the work. Started, not completed.

positives.english: New water pipelines and an overhead tank have started in some city mohallas
positives.hindi: शहर में नई पाइपलाइन और टंकी का काम कुछ मोहल्लों में शुरू हुआ
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (20 Jun 2026): Jal Nigam is spending Rs 170 crore under the restructured drinking water scheme; 268 km pipeline planned across all 37 wards; construction of an overhead tank has begun in Begum Sarai and pipe laying is under way in Shahzadi Sarai; work so far only in demo zones; no completion date given. Started, not delivered.

positives.english: Work to fill potholes on district roads has started and should finish within a month
positives.hindi: सड़कों के गड्ढे भरने का काम शुरू हुआ, एक महीने में पूरा होने की बात
positives.basis: District-level, AC membership unconfirmed: Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026) reports PWD pothole filling started on the Sambhal-Chandausi road at Janeta and the Sambhal-Gawan road at Khirni; XEN said it would finish within a month. Work was delayed by monsoon rains. The Rs 1.50 crore figure is in the headline only.

positives.english: The new district panchayat office building has been completed
positives.hindi: जिला पंचायत का नया कार्यालय भवन बनकर तैयार हो गया
positives.basis: District-level, AC membership unconfirmed: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026), datelined Bahjoi, reports a Rs 7.23 crore district panchayat office building near Bahpurpatti village on Sambhal Road was completed in 18 months and inaugurated by the in-charge minister. The office had run from rented buildings before. Weakest positive: a government building, not a direct service.

positives.english: The municipal board says about 75 percent of the drains have been cleaned
positives.hindi: नगर पालिका का दावा है, करीब 75 फीसदी नाले साफ हो गए
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (6 Jul 2026): sanitation inspector Asif says about 75% of drains have been cleaned and the rest will be done soon; Rs 33 lakh spent. The same report quotes residents in Halluserai, Dehli Darwaza and Nai Sarai saying regular cleaning never happened. This is an official claim that residents dispute, so it is a weak positive.

negatives.english: Just an hour of rain floods Shankar Chauraha and the roadways bus stand
negatives.hindi: एक घंटे की बारिश में शंकर चौराहा और रोडवेज बस स्टैंड पानी में डूब जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Sambhal (3 Aug 2026): about one hour of heavy rain left much of the city waterlogged; water collected at Shankar Chauraha, Hospital Chauraha, the Roadways bus stand, the district hospital premises, Yashoda Market, Dehli Darwaza, Bhure Shah Road and Hatimsarai; it stayed for hours; the EO said pumps are used and most drains need rebuilding after the rains. A second report (Amar Ujala, 12 Aug 2026) describes 2-3 feet of water on roads from the Chandausi crossing toward the government hospital and Shankar Chauraha after four hours of rain.

negatives.english: The drains never get properly cleaned, they are full of garbage
negatives.hindi: नाले कभी साफ नहीं होते, कूड़े से अटे पड़े हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Sambhal (7 Jun 2026): drains blocked with garbage in Halloo Sarai, near Azad Girls Inter College, Dehli Darwaza, near Manokamna Mandir, Hasanpur Marg, Bhure Shah Road and Nai Sarai; residents warn overflowing drains are an accident risk. Amar Ujala (6 Jul 2026) repeats the list and quotes a Dehli Darwaza resident: 'नाला कभी साफ ही नहीं होता'. Sarai Tarin traders say the road waterlogs in rain.

negatives.english: The district hospital has a severe shortage of doctors, so we have to go to Moradabad for treatment
negatives.hindi: जिला अस्पताल में डॉक्टरों की भारी कमी है, इलाज के लिए मुरादाबाद जाना पड़ता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Sambhal (11 Aug 2026): district hospital has 10 of 23 sanctioned posts filled, specialists are missing, and the CMS post is vacant; the DM wrote to the state on 27 July and no postings had been made. Patients must travel about 35 km to Moradabad's divisional hospital or pay private doctors. The article's own headline figures (123 doctors needed, 28 available) do not fully reconcile with its body figures. The district hospital is in Sambhal city, as the 3 Aug 2026 report places it among the city's waterlogged spots.

negatives.english: Power was out for five hours in Hallu Sarai after the poles snapped
negatives.hindi: हल्लूसराय में पांच घंटे बिजली गुल रही, बिजली के खंभे टूटे
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Sambhal (10 Oct 2026): heavy rain on Friday snapped three poles in Hallu Sarai and two in Asmoli; power was out in several areas for about five hours. Only the Hallu Sarai part is used here, since Asmoli is in AC 32 (Chandausi/Asmoli seat per the 2026 polling-station list). Hallu Sarai is a Sambhal city mohalla per the 6 Jul 2026 Amar Ujala report. One-time outage, not a chronic issue.

negatives.english: Sambhal has a weak rail network, and the Sambhal-Gajraula line is still not built
negatives.hindi: संभल में रेल नेटवर्क कमजोर है, गजरौला वाली लाइन अब तक नहीं बनी
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Patrika (4 Apr 2026) reports MP Ziaur Rahman Barq asked the Railway Minister to approve extending the Sambhal-Gajraula line and a new Delhi link; the article says no concrete step has been taken, and the only service is a two-coach demo train from Hatim Sarai to Bilari, Raja ka Sahaspur and Moradabad, twice a day, with freight discontinued. A 2011 Lok Sabha answer put the Gajraula-Mainpuri line cost at Rs 898.44 crore; not sanctioned.

notes: AC identity confirmed on the Wikipedia page for Sambhal Assembly constituency: No. 33, Sambhal, district Sambhal, reserved status None; the page does not list the constituency's extent, so AC membership of each place is inferred from Amar Ujala's Sambhal-city datelines and mohalla names, and is not confirmed against an official extent list. Places excluded as outside AC 33: Chandausi (AC 31), Asmoli (AC 32), Ajimganj/Majra Azimganj, Awas Vikas Colony (Chandausi), Shaktinagar (Chandausi dateline), Ganesh Colony (Chandausi), and the village reports of 4 May 2026 (Jal Jeevan Mission, Alam Sarai, Chaupur Danda etc.), whose AC was not confirmed. Sugarcane dues: ChiniMandi (25 Aug 2026) reports a Rashtriya Kisan Mazdoor Sangh sit-in outside the District Cane Officer's office in Sambhal over pending interest and cheque issues, citing Amar Ujala; the original Amar Ujala article could not be found, so this is not used. A ChiniMandi item also names Venus Sugar Mill, Mazhavali (Rs 32.78 crore dues) but is roughly 194 days old and the AC of Mazhavali is unconfirmed, so it is not used. Field check: the Sambhal drinking water scheme, drain cleaning claim and hospital staffing should be verified on the ground; the 2024 Sambhal violence and the Shahi Jama Masjid matter were deliberately left out as not civic issues. The Patrika rail article's date label in search results read 29 Jul 2026 while the fetched page says 4 Apr 2026; the fetched date is used. Water-supply complaints in Sambhal found in searches were village or Chandausi reports and are not used as city negatives.
